say:0:1123103001:0.text: The Grimmaw Clan is so brutal! Such a cruel tradition!
say:0:1123103001:0.source_cn: 黑嚎氏族真是可怕，竟然有这么残酷的传统！

say:1:1123103002:0.text: Perhaps it stems from the desert itself. Let's head out.
say:1:1123103002:0.source_cn: 或许跟沙漠的环境有关吧，我们先过去瞧瞧。
say:1:1123103002:0.male: Perhaps it stems from the desert itself. Let's head out.
say:1:1123103002:0.female: Perhaps it stems from the desert itself. Let's head out.
